✦ a few words I should say more often

A Letter for you

Dear Mum,

I don't say this enough, and that's honestly part of why I made this. So that on the days I forget the words, you can come back here and read them again.

You've been the quietest, steadiest force in my entire life. You held things together when they were hard. You celebrated us when there wasn't much to celebrate. You made ordinary days feel safe in a way I'm only now starting to understand.

I think about all the small things you did that I didn't notice as a kid — packing the lunches, learning the names of every friend, staying up later than you should have. I notice now. I notice all of it.

I hope this year is good to you. Slower, softer, kinder. The kind of year where someone takes care of you the way you've always taken care of us.

Happy Birthday, Mum.
I love you. Always.

With all my love — Your child ✦
